summary: Horizon Technology Finance Corporation filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, announcing that its board declared monthly cash distributions of $0.06 per share for January, February, and March 2027, totaling $0.18 per share. Ex-dividend and record dates are December 16, 2026, January 19, 2027, and February 18, 2027, with payments January 15, February 17, and March 16, 2027. The board sets distribution levels quarterly based on operating results and spillover income. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
